rows.text_1::eng: Food is anything that people eat or drink to provide the body with energy and nutrients.
rows.text_2::eng: Food helps the body grow, stay strong, and remain healthy.

rows.text_1::eng: Nutrition is the process of obtaining and providing the body with the required nutrients necessary for growth and development.
rows.image_text::eng: Good nutrition is achieved by eating a balanced diet that includes a variety of different foods.

rows.text_1::eng: Farmers produce different types of food that the body needs to stay healthy and strong.
rows.text_2::eng: These foods play different roles in the body, so it is important to eat a variety of them. Here are some of the examples:

rows.section_1_text::eng:
These food provides the body with the strength needed to carry out daily activities such as farming, walking, and working. 
Eat them regularly to keep your energy high.
rows.section_1_extra_text::eng:
* Maize
* Rice 
* Cassava 
* Sweet potatoes
* Millet
* Sorghum
* Wheat
* Irish potatoes
* Cassava
* Arrow roots
* Yams
* Sweet potatoes
* Green bananas
* Sugarcane

rows.section_1_text::eng:
These foods help the body to grow, repair damaged tissues, and build muscles. 
They are very important for children, pregnant women, and people who are recovering from sickness.
rows.section_1_extra_text::eng:
* Groundnuts
* Beans
* Soya beans
* Sim sim
* Mushrooms
* Green grams
* Nuts

rows.section_1_text::eng: Glow foods help the body to fight diseases and maintain good health. They supply vitamins and minerals that strengthen the immune system and keep the body functioning properly.
rows.section_1_extra_text::eng:
* Vegetables
* Oranges
* Amaranthus 
* Watermelon
* Kales 
* Cabbage 
* Spinach
* Avocado
* Ripe bananas
* Pumpkin
* Onions
* Tomatoes
* Beverages, eg, coffee, tea

rows.text_1::eng: Some groups of people require special types of food because their bodies are growing, weak, or recovering from illness. Providing the right food helps improve their health and overall well-being.

rows.title::eng: Children below the age of five years
rows.media_transcript::eng:
Children under five need plenty of “grow” and “glow” foods to support their physical and mental development. For the first six months, breast milk is very important as it provides all the nutrients a baby needs. After six months, we gradually introduce other foods.

These include eggs after nine months, mashed pumpkin mixed with bananas, and nutritious porridge made from ingredients like millet, soya, omena, milk, cassava, and groundnuts. We can also give fruits as smoothies or whole fruits, as well as mashed potatoes. Warm water is also important to keep children hydrated.

Elderly people often have difficulty chewing or digesting food, so they need soft and easily digestible meals to stay healthy and maintain strong immunity.

They can eat foods such as bone soup, porridge, and soft fruits. Other good options include sweet potatoes, green leafy vegetables, and sorghum ugali.

They can also take nutrient-rich foods like liver, especially for those who have lost teeth, as well as pumpkin seeds.

Pregnant and nursing mothers need extra nutrients to stay healthy and support the baby’s development. They should eat foods rich in iron, proteins, and vitamins.

These include porridge, soup, fruits, groundnuts, lean meat, and traditional vegetables like managu, njahe, and sim sim. They can also eat chicken, fish, and omena.

Sick people need foods that are easy to eat and digest because their bodies are weak. These foods help them recover faster, while enough fluids help keep the body hydrated and support the fight against infections.

They can take milk, fruits, porridge, cooked or boiled bananas, bone soup is good for providing strength, especially for joints, soft ugali, and vegetables.

rows.text_1::eng: Value addition is the process of improving a product to make it better, last longer, and sell at a higher price.
rows.image_text::eng: You can transform raw milk into yogurt, adding significant value through superior preservation and a much higher market price, hence boosting your income.

rows.section_1_text::eng: Bananas can be processed into products such as crisps, flour, juice, and snacks.
rows.section_1_extra_text::eng: Helps bananas last longer, reduces spoilage, and increases market value.

rows.section_1_text::eng: Fish can be preserved and processed into products such as smoked fish, fish fillets, and dried fish.
rows.section_1_extra_text::eng: Increases shelf life and reduces wastage.

rows.section_1_text::eng: Sweet potatoes can be processed into crisps, flour, and other food products.
rows.section_1_extra_text::eng: Helps reduce spoilage and increases the demand for sweet potato products.

rows.section_1_text::eng: Soya beans can be turned into nutritious products such as flour, milk, cooking oil, and snacks.
rows.section_1_extra_text::eng: Improves the nutritional value and increases the selling price of soya products.

rows.section_1_text::eng: Cassava can be processed into flour and other high-value food products.
rows.section_1_extra_text::eng: Improves taste, storage life, and market value.

rows.section_1_text::eng: Vegetables can be preserved through drying and processing into different products.
rows.section_1_extra_text::eng: Helps reduce post-harvest losses and food waste.

rows.section_1_text::eng: Groundnuts can be processed into products such as peanut butter, cooking paste, and snacks.
rows.section_1_extra_text::eng: Increases the value and attractiveness of groundnut products.

rows.title::eng: Quality and safety of value-added products
rows.text_1::eng: Maintaining quality and safety is essential in value addition, as it builds customer trust and improves market success.
rows.text_2::eng: To achieve this, it is important to follow good practices when handling your products.
rows.section_1_text::eng: * Using fresh and healthy raw materials ensures that the final product is safe and of good quality. Avoid using spoiled or damaged produce.

rows.title::eng: Quality and safety of value-added products
rows.section_1_text::eng: * Cleanliness during processing is essential. Always keep your hands, tools, and working environment clean to prevent contamination.
rows.section_2_text::eng: * Proper sorting helps remove damaged or unwanted items, improving the overall quality of the final product.

rows.title::eng: Quality and safety of value-added products
rows.section_1_text::eng: * Good storage protects products from moisture, pests, and contamination. Always store products in clean and dry containers.
rows.section_2_text::eng: * Attractive and proper packaging makes products easier to sell and gives customers confidence in their quality.
